newsitem.title: USA: Grubb & Ellis to relocate headquarters.
newsitem.headline: Grubb & Ellis to relocate headquarters.

text.p: Grubb & Ellis Co said Wednesday it plans to move its corporate headquarters to Chicago from San Francisco early next year.

The relocation is expected to be completed by March 31, 1997. The move is expected to cost about $2 million. The company said in a statement its San Francisco commercial brokerage operation will not be affected.
The move was spurred by a desire to be closer to many of its biggest clients most of which are based in the Eastern and Midwestern regions of the U.S.
The firm said San Francisco-based corporate employees have been offered the opportunity to relocate to Chicago and that those that choose not to move will be offered outplacement services.
